answer: Mechanism: bonded identity. Every agent posts a stake in Juniper, the network's bond token, before its actions carry weight; voting power equals stake, not copy count. Reputation accrues only over a rolling horizon of honest settlements, so fresh puppets start near zero. Echo checks flag agents submitting near-identical text or timing as one signer. Attacker cost: N clones need N full Juniper stakes, each frozen separately and slashed when a clone echoes another - no pooling, no discount. Honest users stake once and recover it with rewards.
